title: The Distribution and Gaps Between Prime Numbers Along the Third Axis of a Number Line
content: The distribution of prime numbers among natural numbers is very random. Despite the efforts of countless brilliant researchers throughout history, no pattern has been discovered that can predict their location with certainty. In this paper, I present a numerical structure that defines the location of prime numbers, distinguishing them from even and odd composite numbers. However, prime numbers will remain unpredictable. Nevertheless, this structure will facilitate the discovery of a more precise function that will help us understand how prime numbers are distributed.
